description.zh: 在 Operit 持久终端中管理本地 workbuddy2api 反代服务（Python，默认 8790 端口）。支持配置、启动、停止、状态查询与打开管理后台。注意：WorkBuddy 反代存在封号风险，建议使用小号。
description.en: Manage a local workbuddy2api reverse proxy (Python, default port 8790) through Operit's persistent terminal session. Configure, start, stop, check status and open the admin console. Note: the WorkBuddy proxy carries account-ban risk, please use a secondary account.

description.zh: 通过 Operit 持久终端会话（visible，非 hidden）管理 workbuddy2api 反代进程：启动、停止、状态查询、打开管理后台。
description.en: Manage the workbuddy2api proxy process through Operit's persistent (visible) terminal session: start, stop, status check, and open the admin console.
